"use strict";
function isPrime(n) {
  if (n < 2) {
    return false;
  }
  let d = 2;
  while (d * d <= n) {
    if (n % d === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    d = d + 1;
  }
  return true;
}
let count = 0;
{
  let n = 2;
  while (n < 100) {
    if (isPrime(n)) {
      console.log(n);
      count = count + 1;
    }
    n = n + 1;
  }
}
console.log("primes below 100:");
console.log(count);
